ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Using NTFS Reparse Point - Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using NTFS reparse point and wusa.exe DLL hijacking (UACMe 36)

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX("^\\"C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\wusa\\\.exe\\"\\ \\ \\/quiet\\ C\\:\\\\Users\\\\") AND process_command_line = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\update\\\.msu$") AND (process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288")) OR (parent_process_command_line = "\"C\:\\Windows\\system32\\dism\.exe\"\ \/online\ \/quiet\ \/norestart\ \/add\-package\ \/packagepath\:\"C\:\\Windows\\system32\\pe386\"\ \/ignorecheck" AND (process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\dismhost\\\.exe\\ \\{.*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\DismHost\\\.exe$")))
